text:
alex: CI went red on main after today's lockfile regen. integration tests failing in tests/integration/test_http_client.py — anyone else?

maria: saw it on the dashboard, started after the poetry lock refresh yesterday evening. Looks like a transitive bump from httpx -> httpcore. Repro locally with py311 tox env.

jamal: can you paste the failing traceback? I can try a bisect if needed.

alex: here's the failing snippet from pytest output:

```
E       TypeError: handle_error() got an unexpected keyword argument 'transport'

tests/integration/test_http_client.py:42: TypeError
```

ci-bot: Build #4892 failed: pytest -q tests/integration/test_http_client.py (exit code 1)

maria: that signature change smells like httpcore bumped and changed callback args. Poetry.lock diff: httpx 0.23.3 -> 0.23.4 pulled httpcore 0.17.0 (was 0.16.3).

jamal: ok can do a lock-bisect. Command I'll run: `tools/lock-bisect --fail-cmd "pytest -q tests/integration/test_http_client.py" --start HEAD~30 --end HEAD`

alex: thanks. short-term can we pin httpcore back to 0.16.3 in pyproject.toml extras to get CI green? I can open a quick PR.

maria: pin PR sounds right — but let's confirm bisect first in case it's our code relying on the new signature incorrectly.

jamal: bisect finished, culprit is the lock regenerate commit 9f3a2c (poetry lock regen). It brought in httpcore 0.17.0. Reproduces locally when I pip install --no-deps -r .venv/requirements.txt with httpcore==0.17.0.

alex: opened PR #3245 to pin httpcore==0.16.3 in constraints and trigger CI. cc @jamal @maria

ci-bot: Job triggered for PR #3245: build #4894 (running)

jamal: reran main CI once without pin, still red. reran on PR with pin — running.

ci-bot: Build #4894 (PR #3245) succeeded — tests passing 

alex: merging the pin to get main green. Follow-up: we'll add a short integration test to exercise the callback and file an upstream issue with httpcore about the breaking change.

maria: leaving a note in the release notes: "Pinned httpcore to 0.16.3 due to breaking handler signature change in 0.17.0; follow-up to re-evaluate after httpcore patch."

jamal: will open a small patch to our http client wrapper to be compatible if upstream keeps the change.

alex: thanks all — great quick triage. :thumbsup:
